% =============================================================================
% awesomecv_standin.tex — a SYNTHETIC stand-in, NOT anyone's CV.
%
% It exists so the test suite and the image build can compile a real document
% without a real CV entering git. The package set is deliberately the macro-heavy
% one a popular modern template (awesome-cv style) relies on — fontspec with an
% OpenType font, paracol/tabularx, enumitem, titlesec, hyperref, geometry — plus
% its own \newcommand entry macro. If this compiles, a simpler document will too,
% so the measurement is conservative (D-61). No third-party template is vendored.
%
% The main font is declared BY FILENAME with an explicit face map, not by symbolic
% name: Tectonic resolves fonts by filename, TeX Live by kpathsea, and this form
% resolves in both (Pitfall 4). The by-symbolic-name form is kept commented below
% so the plan-04-05 spike can compile it once and record what the engine accepted.
% =============================================================================
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage{fontspec}
\usepackage{geometry}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{paracol}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{hyperref}

\setmainfont{texgyrepagella}[
  Extension      = .otf,
  UprightFont    = *-regular,
  ItalicFont     = *-italic,
  BoldFont       = *-bold,
  BoldItalicFont = *-bolditalic,
]

% --- SPIKE (do not activate): the by-symbolic-name declaration ---------------
% \setmainfont{TeX Gyre Pagella}
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

\geometry{margin=1in}
\hypersetup{hidelinks}

% An entry macro whose body uses #1/#2/#3 — the macro-heavy case D-61 chooses.
\newcommand{\cventry}[3]{%
  \noindent\textbf{#1} --- \textit{#2} \hfill #3\par\vspace{2pt}%
}

\titleformat{\section}{\large\bfseries}{}{0pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{4pt}

\begin{document}

\begin{center}
  {\LARGE\bfseries Alex Example}\\[2pt]
  alex.example@example.invalid\\
  \href{https://example.invalid/alex}{example.invalid/alex}
\end{center}

\section{Experience}

\cventry{Northwind Labs}{Senior Engineer}{2021-03 -- 2024-09, Dublin, IE}

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.2em,itemsep=1pt]
  \item Reduced p99 latency 40\% by rewriting the ingest path
  \item Led the migration to a single-writer queue
  \item Mentored four engineers through their first on-call rotation
\end{itemize}

\section{Skills}

\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}lX@{}}
  Languages & Python \\
  Databases & PostgreSQL \\
  Infrastructure & Terraform \\
\end{tabularx}

\end{document}
